$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-REHAB-002 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §10.5 and the RF-REHAB-002 inventory entry. Mixed-source rule. Expresses loading-dimension ONTOLOGY / SELECTION-CONSTRAINT structure only: exercise candidates may be described by muscle length, movement speed, contraction mode, load, complexity, and sport specificity. These are ontology metadata that may constrain exercise selection ONLY after the RF-REHAB-001 prescription-input gate is satisfied. QRF-020 does not prove a universal ordering or dosage; the chosen progression must be justified by stage, capacity, monitoring, and separately governed content. No universal sequence, mandatory order, phase/stage/readiness criteria, dosage, exercise plan, complete plan, RTT, or RTS logic; safety precedence preserved; does not bypass RF-REHAB-001 or override RF-SAF-006/RF-DX-008/RF-SEV-004/RF-SEV-005. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.
rule_title: Loading dimensions are ontology metadata, not a universal sequence

input_contract.$comment: The exact loading dimensions taken verbatim from v1.2 §10.5. They are exercise ontology metadata only; they may constrain selection only after the RF-REHAB-001 prescription-input gate is satisfied.

decision_contract.$comment: Ontology / selection-constraint structure only. Loading dimensions describe exercise candidates and may constrain selection after upstream gates permit; they are not a universal sequence, mandatory order, or phase/stage/readiness criteria, and create no dosage, exercise plan, complete plan, RTT, or RTS. QRF-020 does not prove ordering or dosage. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Mixed normative source; MAY. Dual/contextual permitted_use in the body: logic_with_uncertainty for ontology selection; evidence_record_only for any proposed sequence — the inventory/object record the primary permitted_use (logic_with_uncertainty) and the dual role is captured structurally in decision_contract (ontology_selection_permitted_use / proposed_sequence_permitted_use). Architecture refs and evidence claim preserved per source: V3.1-13 (rehab prescription/scheduling/monitoring), V3.1-35 (exercise knowledge system); QRF-020 (E1) bounded to its loading-dimension ontology/reference role and not generalized into a universal RF rehabilitation sequence or dosage. Loading dimensions preserved exactly from §10.5: muscle length, movement speed, contraction mode, load, complexity, and sport specificity. Per §10.5 limit: QRF-020 does NOT prove a universal ordering or dosage; the chosen progression must be justified by stage, capacity, monitoring, and separately governed content. Loading dimensions may be recorded as exercise ontology metadata and may help constrain exercise selection only AFTER the RF-REHAB-001 prescription-input gate is satisfied; they are never a universal sequence or mandatory order for all RF patients, and create no phase-entry/stage-progression/readiness criteria, dosage, complete exercise plan, complete rehab plan, or return-to-training/return-to-sport decision. Safety-state choice (read §10.5 exactly): §10.5 does NOT assign a closed V3.1 safety state, so safety_state_output is null and blocked_targets is empty, and the loading-dimension constraints are represented in decision_contract; no safety state was inferred by analogy. The rule does not bypass RF-REHAB-001 and does not override RF-SAF-006, RF-DX-008, RF-SEV-004, or RF-SEV-005; uncertainty is preserved when exercise metadata is incomplete, source quality is weak, or the loading dimension cannot be safely determined. Rehabilitation ontology/selection-constraint rule, not a safety rule. No exercise-selection engine is authored here (deferred to the later rehab selection and planning objects). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
